production_adoption: Pending root image review; game GLBs/adapter untouched by this task.

coordinate_frame.axes: Blender X right, Y back, Z up; face toward -Y
coordinate_frame.input: Rest/bind coordinates, before Armature evaluation. The reference mesh/rig matrices are identity.
coordinate_frame.transformed_mesh: Evaluate in the canonical rest frame; transform the returned displacement back with the inverse mesh basis before writing a local-space shape key.
coordinate_frame.godot_conversion: Godot (x,y,z) corresponds to Blender (x,-z,y); convert the returned delta inversely.

recommended_candidate: cheek-supported for review; the wider C2 support reduces localized lip compression and stays below the eyes.
formula: For each left/right corner: r2=sum(((point-corner)/radii)^2); w=max(0,1-r2)^3. delta += (side*spread,-forward,lift)*w. No UV or image sampling in the displacement field.
lod_regeneration_order: Finish seam welding/topology repair and decimation for every LOD first. Do not apply a Decimate modifier on a mesh already carrying the prototype shape keys.

On each finalized LOD, create Basis and one actual Smile key from that mesh. Evaluate smile_delta independently at every rest vertex in the shared canonical frame. Do not transfer by vertex indices or copy the old LOD0 key array.

Already-coincident UV/normal-seam vertices must receive one identical delta; the prototype groups at 1e-7 m and evaluates the mean point once. Preserve UV loops, weights, material/atlas and skin bindings.
Keep Smile name/order consistent across LODs, export actual POSITION/NORMAL morph deltas, then verify the adapter preserves values during LOD swaps.
Review strengths 0/.5/1 in front/three-quarter, plus real idle/talk, head gaze and town-camera readability before adopting.
limits: No oral cavity, speech/lip-sync, jaw or brow extension.
The existing painted neutral face already smiles softly; this adds a small real mouth-corner lift.
Input topology is somewhat asymmetric: at full strength the painted left/right mouth corners rise about 2.92/4.03 mm in the wider candidate; the middle rises .13 mm.
No production model/skin/clip/core file changed; no actual game or Godot material acceptance in this prototype.
fingerprint_policy: Fingerprints identify inputs/outputs only; they are not tests, checks, visual-regression verdicts or pass/fail gates.
